# Architecture

Ledgerline is one Node.js service (Express) backed by PostgreSQL and an
S3-compatible object store. The same process serves the HTTP API, runs the
import worker, and runs two timers: scheduled exports and the weekly rollup
email. The React components in `src/components/` are bundled

input.body:
label: question
file: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md

The original uploaded files are kept only temporarily. After a successful import, the worker deletes the uploaded file from object storage, retaining only the parsed transactions. If an upload fails to import, the file is kept for 7 days so it can be inspected, then deleted by an hourly purge.

This behavior is explained in the docs/ARCHITECTURE.md file under the Imports section, specifically under "What happens to uploaded files."
